_about: Every company's name comes from its token's onchain metadata (Metaplex). An entry here either adds a project name, quoted verbatim from a published article ('quote', with 'published' and 'read' dates; the build checks that the quote names the token's onchain symbol), or only links an article for reading ('reading'), which never changes a name and is never quoted. Nothing else from an article is used as a fact. Sources and their terms are listed in DECISIONS.md and erevna/02-piges.md.

RNGRtJMbCveqCp7AC6U95KmrdKecFckaJZiWbPGm.quote: In March 2026, $RNGR token holders voted to liquidate Ranger Finance’s treasury via MetaDAO’s futarchy-based governance system.
